overall_assessment: MF section extraction is systematically wrong: obligatory activities are filed under assessment, course_content is only a heading stub while the real description is dropped, reading_list never contains a reading list (only library boilerplate plus the course-responsible person's name/email), and learning_outcomes regularly loses its first bullet and gains admin text. All 20 packet courses show the same template-driven defects, so they are institution-wide (no random controls were supplied).

findings.evidence: ha godkjent fremmøte (minst 75%) i forelesningen og seminarundervisningen
findings.description: The 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' block (pass/approve gates) is emitted as part of assessment, prefixed to the exam text. Per the codebook these belong in coursework_requirements. Only RL1013 (heading 'Listen over obligatoriske aktiviteter:') got a separate coursework_requirements row, and PPU1020 put the block into course_content; the other ~17 courses have no coursework_requirements row at all.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The MF heading 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' is not mapped to coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R (it fires only as a stub course_content row), and the following text is appended to the next section 'Avsluttende vurdering/eksamen' (assessment).
findings.suggested_fix: Add a pattern '^Obligatoriske aktiviteter' (and 'Listen over obligatoriske aktiviteter') mapped to coursework_requirements in R/section_heading_map.R, ordered before generic course_content patterns; the body up to 'Avsluttende vurdering/eksamen' must go to that section.

findings.description: course_content is emitted as a 25-char row containing only the heading text 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' (pre-pass flags leak->coursework_requirements,boilerplate). It is a placeholder, not course content.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The heading 'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' matches a course_content pattern in R/section_heading_map.R and its body is routed elsewhere.
findings.suggested_fix: Remap the heading to coursework_requirements and drop heading-only rows in .clean_sections() in R/extract_sections.R (text remaining after removing the heading shorter than ~30 chars).

findings.evidence: Dette emnet gir en innføring i samfunnsvitenskapelige perspektiver på identitet og identitetskonstruksjon
findings.description: The descriptive intro paragraphs after the metadata block ('Timeplan') and before 'Om studiet' are the real course content, but no extractor row contains them in any of the 20 courses. They are silently dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The plan has no heading before the intro, so the splitter starts the first section at 'Om studiet'/'Obligatoriske aktiviteter' and discards the preamble.
findings.suggested_fix: In R/extract_sections.R add a preamble rule for MF: text between the 'Timeplan' line (end of the Emneinfo/Studieprogramtilhørighet block) and the first mapped heading is assigned to course_content; strip the Emneinfo metadata lines first.

findings.evidence: Noe av litteraturen er digital, annet finnes kun i papirutgave. Kompendier kan være tilgjengelige i Canvas.
findings.description: reading_list contains only the generic 'Tilgang til litteratur' library-access boilerplate (identical in every course) and the stub 'Litteraturlisten for høst 2026'. No actual reading list is present, so the row carries no information.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The literature list on MF pages is loaded dynamically and is absent from the harvested HTML; the extractor maps 'Litteraturliste' to reading_list and takes whatever follows.
findings.suggested_fix: Strip the fixed 'Tilgang til litteratur' paragraph and the stub line 'Litteraturlisten for ...' in .clean_sections(); emit no reading_list row when nothing remains.

findings.evidence: Emneansvarlig John Kaufman, John Førsteamanuensis John.Kaufman@mf.no Studentlivet på MF Vurderer du å studere på MF?
findings.description: The page footer ('Emneansvarlig' block with personal name, title and e-mail, plus 'Studentlivet på MF' marketing and links) is appended to reading_list. It is page chrome, not course content, and leaks personal data. The same footer also ends up in learning_outcomes for PRA1005 and PRA1004.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No end-of-content delimiter for the MF page: the last section runs to the end of the extracted text. Names/emails remain verbatim in the section text.
findings.suggested_fix: In .clean_sections() (or an MF hook) truncate every section at the first line matching '^Emneansvarlig$' and drop everything after it.

findings.evidence: god kunnskap om lov- og planverk samt skolen som organisasjon
findings.description: The first bullet after a KUNNSKAP sub-heading is lost: PPU1015 loses 'god kunnskap om lov- og planverk...', PED1010 loses 'god kunnskap om pedagogikk, med vekt på skolens oppgaver, læring og danning', SAM1000L, PED5610 and RL5065 likewise. In PRA1001 the only knowledge outcome ('kunnskap om skolemiljø og lærerrollen') is lost, leaving a bare 'Studenten har' line.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The first line after the 'KUNNSKAP' sub-heading is consumed with the heading (off-by-one in the heading/body split) or matched by a heading pattern.
findings.suggested_fix: Anchor sub-heading patterns in R/section_heading_map.R to whole lines ('^(KUNNSKAP|FERDIGHETER|GENERELL KOMPETANSE)$', case-insensitive) and treat them as labels, not boundaries; verify in R/extract_sections.R that the first body line after a heading is retained.

findings.evidence: god kunnskap om undervisning i religions- og livssynsemner
findings.description: In PRA1005 four knowledge bullets ('god kunnskap om undervisning i religions- og livssynsemner', 'god kunnskap om samspillet...', ...) are appended to assessment after the 'bestått eller ikke bestått' sentence, while learning_outcomes starts with an empty 'Studenten har' line. Learning outcomes are filed as assessment.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The 'Kunnskap' sub-heading/Læringsutbytte boundary is not recognised for this page variant, so the bullets stay in the preceding assessment section.
findings.suggested_fix: Same as truncation fix: anchor sub-heading patterns to whole lines and ensure 'Læringsutbytte' always starts learning_outcomes.

findings.evidence: DELEMNE C: PRAKSIS 30 DAGER Litteraturlisten for vår 2026
findings.description: In PPU1015 the last learning-outcome bullets of delemne DIDAKTIKK ('reflektere over og utvikle egen faglige praksis', 'videreutvikle sin kompetanse gjennom arbeid med fag- og forskningslitteratur', ...) and the 'DELEMNE C' heading are placed in reading_list (flag long), while the delemne C outcomes are merged into learning_outcomes.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: A reading_list pattern probably matches a body line containing 'forskningslitteratur' and starts reading_list mid-outcomes.
findings.suggested_fix: Anchor the reading_list pattern to a full-line heading ('^Litteraturliste$'); never match bullet lines.

findings.evidence: Overlappende emner RL1016 Kristendommens historie og moderne livssynsmangfold overlapper delvis med K1020
findings.description: Administrative 'Overlappende emner' (credit-reduction rules) and the stub 'Litteraturliste / Litteraturlisten for høst 2026' are appended to learning_outcomes. Both are admin noise.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Overlappende emner' is not mapped to any section, so its text is appended to the previous section (headings that map to nothing).
findings.suggested_fix: Add 'Overlappende emner' as a discard/boundary heading in R/section_heading_map.R; remove the 'Litteraturliste' stub line.

findings.evidence: Skriftlig skoleeksamen - Ordinær eksamen Eksamensdato: 18. november 2026 Starttidspunkt: 9:00 Varighet: 4 timer Trekkfrist: 1. november 2026 Sensur kunngjøres innen: 9. desember 2026
findings.description: Assessment includes the exam-logistics table (dates, start time, duration, withdrawal and grading deadlines). The extracted text also differs from the plan (empty 'Starttidspunkt:' becomes '9:00', 'Innleveringsfrist' gains '13:00'), and the 'Ny/utsatt eksamen' header of the second exam is dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Eksamensdatoer' is not cut off from assessment and .clean_sections() does no table cleaning.
findings.suggested_fix: Cut assessment at 'Eksamensdatoer' (or drop lines from 'Eksamensdato:'/'Oppgaven utleveres:' to 'Sensur kunngjøres innen:' plus the following date line) in .clean_sections(); check upstream where the 9:00/13:00 values are injected.

findings.evidence: Arbeidsform og organisering Emnet organiseres i 6 moduler som alle må gjennomføres for å ta eksamen.
findings.description: 'Arbeidsform og organisering' is never extracted into teaching_methods. In RL1014 it is merged into assessment; in PRA1005, PRA1004 and SAM1000L it is dropped.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: No pattern for 'Arbeidsform og organisering' in R/section_heading_map.R, and the preamble is dropped.
findings.suggested_fix: Add '^Arbeidsform( og organisering)?:?$' mapped to teaching_methods in R/section_heading_map.R, ending the section at 'Om studiet'/'Obligatoriske aktiviteter'.

findings.description: An explicit prerequisite line is not extracted. SAM2080L, with the heading 'Forkunnskaper:', does get a prerequisites row, so the pattern exists but does not cover 'Forkunnskapskrav:' inline in the preamble.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The prerequisites pattern matches 'Forkunnskaper' but not 'Forkunnskapskrav', and inline 'Label: text' lines are not split.
findings.suggested_fix: Extend the prerequisites pattern to '^Forkunnskap(er|skrav)' and allow 'Label: text' on one line.

findings.evidence: I dette delemnet fokuseres det på ulike kristne kirkesamfunn: deres historiske bakgrunn, utbredelse, organisering, lære og forskjellige trosuttrykk.
findings.description: In RL1013 the delemne C description paragraph (course content) opens learning_outcomes, out of order, while the delemne A/B descriptions are dropped; also the first knowledge bullet of delemne B is lost.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: 'Delemne X:' headings in the intro are matched to learning_outcomes and fragments are assembled out of order.
findings.suggested_fix: Do not map 'Delemne X:' headings outside the Læringsutbytte block to learning_outcomes; keep them as course_content and preserve document order.
